method.title: 短广告人声的模型词句与时间分歧
method.trigger: 该源多语短口播伴随音乐及紧裁首尾片段时。
method.action: 保留各模型原始结果，针对实际编码音频和完整上下文补证；不能以稿件或混音边界单独裁定语义。
method.failure_signature: 多个语种出现词句或时间分歧，葡语模型给出虚构CTA时间。
limitations: 单源多语；无直接正常速度听审或独立母语验收。
不建立模型排名或通用时间容差。

Quoted observations do not prove causality or validate the proposed action; controller review required.
method.next_counterexample_test: 对分歧短句独立听审实际编码音频，并核对完整上下文。

Short localized ad speech with music and tight head/tail crops

record.hypothesis: ASR and comparative audio models can disagree on short localized ad phrases and timestamps when music, tight crops and mixed speech are present. APC-20261117-060 supports using the final script, measured mix boundaries and actual encoded audio as the deciding evidence while retaining model disagreement as a limitation.
limitations: Spanish, German and French showed lexical or timing disagreement across Whisper, raw TTS and Gemini evidence; Portuguese Gemini hallucinated CTA timing; the complete takes were retained in the encoded mixes.
No direct continuous normal-speed listening or independent native-speaker acceptance was performed.
This observation does not establish a model ranking or a universal timing tolerance.
The candidate records a bounded review method and remains pending broader evidence.
record.promotion: Keep as a source-scoped candidate; do not promote a model hierarchy or waive encoded audio review.
record.evidence_boundary: Exact source, mix and locale scope; new productions require their own script, mix, head/tail and encoded review.

activation: Developer review required; no validated rules changed
